fields.name: award
fields.title: Award
fields.description: The award program or board the nomination goes to, written as the award announcement names it.

fields.name: category_if_applicable
fields.title: Category (if applicable)
fields.description: The award category the nominee competes in. Leave it blank when the award has no categories.

fields.name: award_period
fields.title: Award period
fields.description: The dates the nomination covers, as the award announcement sets them.

fields.name: rankname_of_nominee
fields.title: Rank/name of nominee (first, middle initial, last)
fields.description: The nominee's rank, then first name, middle initial and last name. The form repeats it at the top of page 2.

fields.name: majcom_fldcom_foa_or_dru
fields.title: MAJCOM, FLDCOM, FOA or DRU
fields.description: The nominee's major command, field command, field operating agency or direct reporting unit, by its abbreviation.

fields.name: dafsc_duty_title
fields.title: DAFSC/duty title
fields.description: The nominee's duty AFSC and duty title, separated by a slash.

fields.name: nominees_telephone_dsn_commercial
fields.title: Nominee's telephone (DSN & commercial)
fields.description: The nominee's DSN and commercial phone numbers.

fields.name: unit_office_symbol_street_address_base_state_zip
fields.title: Unit/office symbol/street address/base/state/ZIP code
fields.description: The nominee's unit and office symbol, then street address, base, state and ZIP code, all on one line.
fields.example: 123 CS/SCOO, 100 Example Ave, Notional AFB, CO 80000

fields.name: unit_commander_rank_name_and_telephone
fields.title: Rank/name of unit commander (first, middle initial, last)/commander's telephone (DSN & commercial)
fields.description: The unit commander's rank and name (first, middle initial, last), followed by the commander's DSN and commercial numbers.
fields.example: Lt Col Casey B. Sample, DSN 555-0100, Comm (555) 555-0100

fields.name: accomplishments
fields.title: Specific accomplishments (use performance statements IAW DAFMAN 36-2806)
fields.description: The nominee's accomplishments during the award period, as performance statements IAW DAFMAN 36-2806, one per line, within any limit the award announcement sets.
fields.example: Led an 8-member team that rebuilt the base network core, restoring service to 2,100 users in six hours.

fields.name: rankname_of_nominee
fields.title: Rank/name of nominee (first, middle initial, last)
fields.description: Repeats the nominee's rank and name from page 1 at the top of the continuation page.

fields.name: accomplishments_continued
fields.title: Specific accomplishments (use performance statements IAW DAFMAN 36-2806) (continued)
fields.description: Performance statements that do not fit on page 1, in the same format, one per line. Leave it empty when page 1 holds them all.
fields.example: Mentored four Airmen on CCAF requirements; all four completed their degrees during the period.
